channel.description: Last 10 notes on Origin of Speech

item.title: आचार्य
item.description: आचार्य = आङ् + चर् + ण्यत् here periphery + walk water + push hold float रूढ अर्थ Teacher comment आचार्य seems to refer to action.

इन्द्रवरुणभवशर्वरुद्रमृडहिमारण्ययवयवनमातुलाचार्याणामानुक् 4.1.48 - 4.1.50 SV: इन्द्र-वरुण-भव-शर्व-रुद्र-मृड-हिम-अरण्य-यव-यवन-मातुल-आचार्याणाम् आनुक् AV: ङीष् पुम्-योगात् Language meaning: आनुक् is added to इन्द्र वरुण भव शर्व रुद्र मृड हिम अरण्य यव यवन मातुल आचार्य before the feminine affix ङीष् Mea...

item.title: चर्
item.description: चरँ = च र चंद्र बिंदी walk water again flow रूढ अर्थ गति = moving in water sense भक्षण = भक्ष् + ल्युट् = act of (steady aim) = in sense of walk water संशय = सम् + शी + अच् = act of (together sleep) = in sense of “again flow”.

item.title: मातुल
item.description: inside here this pull + doer of action + be ware sand walk / be ware wet soil walk/ be ware slippery walk inside here this puller + be ware of slippery walk.

item.title: Notice to reader

item.title: डुलच्
item.description: डुलच् = ड उ ल च verb(fear) sand again/walk.

item.title: मातृ
item.description: मातृ = मान् + तृच् inside here this pull + doer of action रूढ अर्थ mother.

item.title: मान्
item.description: मानँ = म अ न चंद्र बिंदी inside untill pull inside here this pull रूढ अर्थ पूजा = पूज् + अ + टाप् स्तम्भ = स्तम्भ् + अच्.

item.title: स्तम्भ्
item.description: ष्टभिँ = ष ट भ इ चंद्र बिंदी hook object(steady) hook object(ground) रूढ अर्थ प्रतिबन्ध = प्रति+ बंध्+ घञ् = act of (towards+ bind pull hold) रोधन = रुध् + ल्युट्.
